faqs.question: What is an agent skill?
faqs.answer: An agent skill is a reusable instruction package that gives an AI coding agent focused guidance for a framework, workflow, or engineering practice.

faqs.question: How do I install an agent skill?
faqs.answer: Choose a skill, copy its npx skills add command, run it from your project directory, and review the installed SKILL.md before using the guidance in your coding agent.

faqs.question: How does Code Dimension select skills for the catalog?
faqs.answer: Code Dimension lists skills it has reviewed or created for practical software-development work. Every catalog entry identifies its creator and explains its scope before installation.

faqs.question: Can AI agents read this catalog without running JavaScript?
faqs.answer: Yes. The catalog is prerendered as static HTML and also publishes llms.txt and skills.md files so search crawlers and AI agents can discover and parse its public content.
